performance.directory_note: Observed win and use rates at {range} brawler trophies over the last 7 UTC days. Unobserved brawlers show —. Open a brawler’s Stats tab for trophy filters and sample sizes.
performance.best_picks_note: {range} trophies · last 7 UTC days · 200+ decisive results · ranked by Wilson lower bound; percentages show observed win rates
performance.no_top_picks: Not enough recorded results to rank this map yet.
performance.equipment_method: We infer an item only when the polled player’s brawler currently owns exactly one gadget, star power, or gear of that type. Profiles do not confirm historical equipment or whether an item was equipped. Win rate uses those inferred samples only; use rate is the item’s share of samples with an inferred item of the same type. These results reflect a restricted ownership cohort.
performance.no_equipment_description: Samples appear when a collected player owns exactly one item of a type. Unknown equipment is excluded.
performance.score_pending: No brawler has {count} decisive results yet. Showing recorded picks first.
performance.read_method: Win rate is wins divided by wins and losses. Use rate is separate and never changes the win-rate calculation.
performance.score_note: The conservative score is the lower end of the approximate 95% Wilson win-rate interval, available from 200 decisive results. It accounts for sample size; use rate is excluded. It does not correct player skill or sampling bias.
performance.tier_range_note: Tier lists compare one trophy range at a time. Select 0–499, 500–999, or 1000+ above or below. All-trophy totals remain available in Statistics.
performance.tier_method: Large percentages show the conservative score; observed win rates appear underneath. Tiers use the Wilson lower bound: S ≥{sThreshold}%, A ≥55%, B ≥50%, C ≥45%, D ≥40%, F <40%. At least {count} decisive results are required in the selected trophy range and period. Use rate never affects placement. These scores do not correct skill or sampling bias.
performance.empty_tier: No qualifying brawlers in this tier.
performance.unrated_description: Fewer than {count} decisive results in these filters. These brawlers are not assigned a tier.
performance.history_note: Each point is an observed UTC battle day. Missing days have no measured rate; history grows as matches are collected.
performance.no_history: No recorded history for these filters
performance.map_distribution_note: Each bar counts maps in a rate band for this brawler. Maps count equally; use rate does not weight win rate.
performance.brawler_distribution_note: Each bar counts brawlers in a rate band on this map. Brawlers count equally; use rate does not weight win rate.
performance.confidence_note: The interval is an approximate 95% Wilson interval for recorded decisive results. It does not correct player-skill, bot, matchmaking, or sampling bias. Extra metrics use only logs that include those fields.
performance.history_description: History is built from ongoing ClickHouse collection. Earlier D1 statistics are not imported. Choose an earlier period-ending date to inspect past win rates, use rates, and results. Days without recorded matches stay absent; late observations can add to an earlier day.
performance.enrichment_note: {count} picks without known battle-time trophies are excluded from trophy-specific filters.
performance.no_decisive_results: No decisive results for this period
performance.trophy_note: Filter by each participant’s brawler trophies at battle time: 0–499, 500–999, or 1000+. Only matching player slots enter use-rate totals.

brawler_stats.title: {name} performance
brawler_stats.description: Win and pick rates from captured trophy 3v3 matches. Filter by period, game mode, or map.
brawler_stats.win_definition: Wins divided by wins and losses. Draws are excluded.
brawler_stats.pick_definition: Share of eligible player slots in the same trophy, mode, map, and date filters.
brawler_stats.picks_definition: One pick per participant. Mirror picks count separately.
brawler_stats.low_sample: Fewer than 200 decisive results. These rates may change substantially as more matches arrive.
brawler_stats.try_again: The collector may not be configured yet, or the service could not be reached. Try again later.
brawler_stats.sample_description: Player tracking uses a leaderboard-seeded registry. These results reflect the captured sample, not the whole player population. Ranked sets, Showdown, and unsupported modes are excluded.
brawler_stats.empty_description: Try a wider period or another mode. New statistics appear after the tracker captures eligible matches.
brawler_stats.map_hint: Explore a map to compare all brawlers, or filter the totals above. Use rates include eligible player slots on that map.
brawler_stats.coverage: {matches} unique matches in this filtered sample. {players} players currently tracked.
brawler_stats.gaps: {count} collections had no overlap with the previous log. Some matches may be missing.
brawler_stats.source: Game data from the Supercell Brawl Stars API. Collection is periodic; complete battle history is not guaranteed.
